reason: It's free and they load the flyers from Instagram for me, so I lose nothing by being on there. I'd say yes to the free listing, but I'm not paying a cent until I see real people coming through the door from it.
objection: 500 people on a waitlist is nothing yet, and my nights get filled by my regulars and WhatsApp lists. I don't believe an app will bring me new people, so I won't pay 39 a month for stats and a badge.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a few of my own customers say they found the night through the app, and paid plans staying optional well after the 2,000 users are reached.
